knowledge:
- key_parameters: pm.distr=Distribution for peak means (default is "weibull", options include "gamma", "lognormal-gamma", or "pareto") ;; nPeaks=Number of peaks to simulate ;; nCells=Number of cells to simulate ;; method=Simulation method (set to "groups" for simulating multiple cell types/groups) ;; nGroups=Number of cell-type groups to simulate ;; group.prob=Vector of proportions for each cell-type group (must sum to 1) ;; nBatches=Number of batches to simulate ;; batchCells=Vector specifying the number of cells in each batch ;; update=A list of parameters to update simultaneously in setsimPICparameters
- alternatives: PICsnATAC (GitHub package/vignette) is recommended for converting raw scATAC-seq files (barcodes, peaks, fragments) into a Paired-Insertion Count (PIC) matrix format before using simPIC
- when_to_use: Appropriate when users need to generate realistic synthetic scATAC-seq datasets that mimic the sparsity, library size, and peak mean characteristics of real data, or when testing downstream single-cell ATAC-seq analysis methods under controlled cell-type compositions and batch effects
- pitfalls: The input count matrix should ideally be a Paired-Insertion Count (PIC) matrix for optimal quantitative information utilization ;; When simulating multiple groups, group.prob must sum to 1 ;; exp.libsize and exp.peakmean in the output metadata represent expected values, not the final simulated counts

workflows.name: pic_matrix_generation
workflows.intent: Generate a Paired-Insertion Count (PIC) matrix from raw single-cell ATAC-seq files.
workflows.stages: 1. Run PIC counting to generate the PIC matrix using PIC_counting.
workflows.code:
pic_mat <- PIC_counting(
    cells = cells,
    fragment_tsv_gz_file_location = fragment_tsv_gz_file_location,
    peak_sets = peak_sets
)

workflows.name: scatac_simulation_and_comparison
workflows.intent: Estimate parameters from a real scATAC-seq count matrix, simulate synthetic datasets with custom parameters (including multiple cell types and batch effects), and compare the simulated data to the real data.
input: test.rds (real scATAC-seq count matrix in dgCMatrix format)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the real count matrix ;; 2. Estimate parameters using simPICestimate ;; 3. Simulate synthetic counts using simPICsimulate ;; 4. Customize simulation parameters using setsimPICparameters and simPICgetparameters ;; 5. Simulate multiple cell types (groups) and batch effects ;; 6. Compare simulated datasets using simPICcompare.
workflows.code:
counts <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "test.rds", package = "simPIC"))
est <- simPICestimate(counts)
sim <- simPICsimulate(est)
sim.params <- newsimPICcount()
sim.params <- setsimPICparameters(sim.params, nPeaks = 2000)
simPICget(sim.params, "nPeaks")
sim.params <- setsimPICparameters(sim.params,
    update = list(nPeaks = 8000, nCells = 500)
)
params <- simPICgetparameters(
    sim.params,
    c("nPeaks", "nCells", "peak.mean.shape")
)
params <- setsimPICparameters(sim.params,
    lib.size.sdlog = 3.5, lib.size.meanlog = 9.07
)
new <- newsimPICcount()
new <- simPICestimate(counts)
sim <- simPICsimulate(new, nCells = 500)
counts(sim)[1:5, 1:5]
head(rowData(sim))
head(colData(sim))
names(assays(sim))
sim1 <- simPICsimulate(nPeaks = 2000, nCells = 500)
sim2 <- simPICsimulate(nPeaks = 2000, nCells = 500)
comparison <- simPICcompare(list(real = sim1, simPIC = sim2))
comparison$Plots$Means
sim <- simPICsimulate(new, method = "groups", 
                nGroups = 2, group.prob = c(0.5, 0.5))
sim_multi <- simPICsimulate(new, method ="groups", 
                            nGroups = 2, 
                            group.prob = c(0.7, 0.3))
sim_batch <- simPICsimulate(new, method="groups",
                            nGroups=2, nBatches=2,
                            group.prob=c(0.5, 0.5),
                            batchCells=c(250,250))
